name: Prefer Performant CPUs
description: Prefers high-performance CPU cores on supported hybrid processors to improve responsiveness and favor stronger cores during demanding tasks.

description_i18n.en: Prefers high-performance CPU cores on supported hybrid processors to improve responsiveness and favor stronger cores during demanding tasks.
description_i18n.de: Bevorzugt auf unterstützten Hybridprozessoren die leistungsstarken CPU-Kerne, um die Reaktionsfähigkeit bei anspruchsvollen Aufgaben zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Privilégie les cœurs de processeur hautes performances sur les processeurs hybrides compatibles afin d'améliorer la réactivité lors des tâches exigeantes.

warnings.message: Administrator privileges required: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply changes.
Advanced tweak: This tweak targets advanced system behavior and should be changed with care.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets the active power plan's AC and DC processor scheduling policy (SUB_PROCESSOR/SCHEDPOLICY) to value 2. Restore sets both values to 5.
